name: Qualitative content analysis
summary: A codebook is developed and tested, agreement between coders is checked against a target, and only then is the full set coded and counted. Works for deductive, inductive, or mixed coding.
notes: Coding is by predefined units, so every coding belongs to a unit and agreement can be counted unit by unit.
Every code needs a definition, inclusion criteria, exclusion criteria, and at least one anchor example before full coding starts.

phases.title: Codebook development
phases.goal: Write the codes: what each means, what counts, what does not, and an example.
memo_prompts: What does the research question need the codes to separate?
Where could two coders reasonably disagree about this code?
exit_checklist: Gave every code a definition, inclusion criteria, and exclusion criteria
Marked an anchor example for every code

phases.title: Pilot coding
phases.goal: Try the codebook on a small sample drawn at random, and note where it was unclear.
memo_prompts: Which definitions did you have to guess at?
exit_checklist: Drew a pilot sample and saved its seed
Noted where the codebook was unclear

phases.title: Agreement check
phases.goal: Have a second coder code the pilot sample without seeing yours, and measure agreement.
memo_prompts: Which codes fall below the target, and why?
exit_checklist: A second coder coded the pilot sample blind
Computed agreement and compared it with the target
Listed the codes under the target with their disagreements

phases.title: Codebook revision
phases.goal: Fix unclear definitions and criteria, and save the result as a numbered version.
memo_prompts: What did the disagreements teach you about the codes?
exit_checklist: Saved a new codebook version with a note
Recoded the pilot sample wherever a code changed

phases.title: Full coding
phases.goal: Code the remaining units with the settled codebook.
memo_prompts: Has your use of any code drifted since the pilot?
exit_checklist: Checked agreement on a later sample to look for drift
Recorded every method decision as a memo

phases.title: Frequency analysis
phases.goal: Count the codes by case and by attribute, and test whether groups differ.
memo_prompts: What do the counts show that the quotes alone could not?
exit_checklist: Counted codes by case and attribute
Tested differences between groups where the design calls for it
Exported the tables for the report
